operation_items.operation: apply the transition to every component carrying the invariant
keep total and entries consistent after a partial-state transition
reject a violating transition without a partial update
precondition check before any component is mutated
the invariant is closed under a sequence of transitions

prompt_intro: The crate builds, but `Ledger` breaks its declared invariant `total == sum(entries)` after a withdrawal and allows an overdraw. Preserve the invariant on every transition: withdraw updates both components, rejects a non-positive amount with `invalid amount`, and rejects an overdraw with `insufficient funds` while leaving the ledger unchanged. Keep the public API.
provenance: original; authored for SELVEDGE P12.9/P11.21 (S14), no public benchmark text

shared_operation.audit: author annotation only; no inter-annotator agreement yet (P11.21 gap)
shared_operation.definition: Given a declared state invariant, apply a transition to every component that carries the invariant, reject a transition that would violate it and leave the state unchanged, and never let a partial update escape.
shared_operation.name: invariant preservation
shared_operation.transfer_rule: A surface is solved only when every task on that surface passes; the trio win requires all three surfaces and is never pooled across them.
